models.description: Factory-built wood fireplace with a 2.6 cu ft firebrick-lined firebox, vented through 7-inch ICC Excel chimney. RSF sells it in Canada only; it is certified to EPA 2015 Step 1 (4.5 g/hr), not EPA 2020.

latest_manuals.title: Focus 320 - Owner's Manual

models.latest_manuals_note: NOT SELLABLE NEW IN THE US: RSF says the Focus 320 is available in Canada only (EPA 2015 Step 1, 4.5 g/hr). Kept because the only manual is a combined US/Canada edition, which counts as an archived US manual: the product page (checked 2026-10-08) links just this one; the cover reads 'RSF-IIF320 2020-02, Operation • Maintenance • Installation'; the text says it meets the 2015 US EPA standard and gives separate US and Canadian rules. It dates from before the May 2020 Step 2 deadline. The Focus SBR (F320SBR) looks like the model to sell in the US.
models.availability_evidence: Live product page on icc-rsf.com and listed in the RSF fireplace menu (2026-10-07). Page says it is 'available in Canada only'. It does not appear in the RSF 2025-06 catalog, which lists the other 8 RSF models.
